title: Ultimate LightningSword
description: A Simple Plugin That Adds /LightningSword To Minecraft Striking a player cause Lighting Bolts To Instant Kill the Player
body:
⚡ Lightning Sword

Bring insane power to your Minecraft server with the Lightning Sword, a custom weapon that strikes lightning on every hit.

This plugin adds a fully custom diamond sword powered by a secure PersistentDataContainer (PDC) system, meaning the item is completely safe from renaming, editing, or duplication tricks.

When you hit a player, lightning instantly strikes them — no cooldown, no right-click, no limits.

🔥 Features
⚡ Lightning strikes on every hit
🗡 Custom maxed diamond sword (OP enchantments up to level 7)
💥 Extra damage + combat effects
🌩 Lightning + thunder sound effects on impact
🧠 Fully PDC-based item system (secure & unbreakable)
🎁 Works with EssentialsX kits (auto-converts items into real sword)
⚙ OP commands for admins:
/lightningsword give <player>
/lightningsword giveall
/lightningsword reload
🧪 Kit Compatibility

You can safely use it inside EssentialsX kits like this:

diamond_sword 1 name:&bLightning_Sword

The plugin will automatically convert it into the real Lightning Sword with full abilities.

⚙ Compatibility
Minecraft Paper 1.21.11
Java 21
EssentialsX supported
LuckPerms compatible
⚠ Notes

This weapon is extremely powerful and designed for OP or SMP events. Every hit triggers lightning, making PvP chaotic and fun.
